message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on Scent Crusher lockers. The product is a floor-standing steel frame storage locker with a zippered fabric enclosure and an ozone generator. Candidate headings are 9403 (other furniture), 8543 (electrical machines with individual functions), and 8421 (air purifying machinery).

I believe the ruling classified it as a composite good under GRI 3(b), with the essential character given by the storage locker, so 9403.20.0090 (other metal furniture) or 9403.20.0080. The 9403.20.00 subheading covers "other metal furniture," and since 2022 the statistical suffixes are 9403.20.0020 (Luggage lockers, other than those of heading 9403.20.0010?), 9403.20.0026 (other), 9403.20.0030, 9403.20.0050, 9403.20.0080, and 9403.20.0090. I am not certain of these suffixes. The 9403.20.0090 suffix is "Other: Other." I'll go with 9403.20.0090.

Another possibility is 9403.20.0080 (Other: Other: Other), but 9403.20.0090 is my best guess.

{"hts_code": "9403.20.0090", "reason": "The floor-standing steel-frame storage locker kit with shelving gives the set its essential character under GRI 3(b), so it is classified as other metal furniture, with the ozone generator and fabric enclosure treated as secondary components."}

predicted_reason: The floor-standing steel-frame storage locker kit with shelving gives the set its essential character under GRI 3(b), so it is classified as other metal furniture, with the ozone generator and fabric enclosure treated as secondary components.
